# Rabia Mansoor

> Independent researcher and PhD scholar in classical geopolitics, world
> literature, popular geopolitics, and the spatial humanities — decoding how
> global power is constructed through narration.

Rabia Mansoor is an independent researcher, educator, and academic administrator
with grant-winning research and peer-reviewed publications. 11+ years teaching
English, Linguistics, and Literary Studies; Cambridge-certified EMI instructor.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://rabiamansoor.com/): overview and tagline.
- [Geopolitical Journal](https://rabiamansoor.com/journal/): dispatches on narrative & power.
- [The Lab](https://rabiamansoor.com/lab/): PhD/MPhil/MA research and publications.
- [The Classroom](https://rabiamansoor.com/classroom/): teaching philosophy & courses.
- [About](https://rabiamansoor.com/about/): full bio, trajectory, grants.

## Selected work
- [National Security Cinema: Hollywood as a Geopolitical Apparatus](https://rabiamansoor.com/articles/national-security-cinema/)
- [Geopolitical Tropes and Popular Geopolitics: The Great Game and Historical Narrative in Rudyard Kipling's Kim (1901)](https://rabiamansoor.com/articles/kim-great-game/) — Journal of European Studies, 2026.
- [Cultural Debate in the 21st Century on Declining Multiculturalism in Europe](https://rabiamansoor.com/articles/declining-multiculturalism-europe/) — Journal of European Studies, 2024.
